title: The Longest Mirror Phrase
statement:
A block of consecutive letters is a mirror if it reads the same from left to right and from right to left. Find the length of the longest mirror block inside the given word.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the length of the longest mirror block.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 1000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
